story_description: As a new user launching Blaze for the first time, I want to see a welcoming screen that introduces the app and guides me to get started, so I feel confident and oriented.
task_description: Build the WelcomeOnboardingView SwiftUI screen with animated logo, headline, value proposition bullets, and Get Started CTA button.
atom_description: Create the first onboarding screen featuring an animated Blaze logo with scale and fade effects, a welcome headline, three value proposition bullet points, and a Get Started button that advances the onboarding flow.
problem_statement: New users opening Blaze for the first time have no context about what the app does or how to begin. Without a welcome screen, users land directly into the main interface feeling disoriented, which increases abandonment and reduces engagement.
scope_in: Animated Blaze logo with scale and fade animation lasting 1.2 seconds
Welcome to Blaze headline text with appropriate typography
Three value proposition bullet points explaining app benefits
Get Started primary button that advances to the next onboarding screen
Accessibility support for reduced motion preference
Integration with OnboardingCoordinator for navigation flow
scope_out: User profile collection (deferred to O003-PROFILE screen)
CLI detection logic (deferred to O004-CLIDETECT screen)
Persistent storage of onboarding completion state (handled by coordinator)
Custom Blaze logo asset creation (assumes asset already exists)
assumptions: OnboardingCoordinator exists and manages screen navigation flow
Blaze logo asset is available in Assets.xcassets
App uses NavigationStack or similar for screen transitions
SwiftUI is the UI framework for all onboarding screens
constraints: Animation must complete within 1.2 seconds to maintain user attention
Must respect system accessibility reduced motion preference
Button must be large enough for touch targets per Apple HIG (44pt minimum)
Screen must work on all supported macOS window sizes
No network calls required for this screen
functional_requirements: FR1: The animated logo shall begin its animation sequence when the view appears on screen
FR2: The animation shall respect the accessibilityReduceMotion system setting by skipping animations when enabled
FR3: Tapping the Get Started button shall navigate the user to the next onboarding screen (O003-PROFILE)
FR4: The three value proposition bullets shall display static text describing key app benefits
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Animation shall complete within 1.2 seconds (1200ms) from view appearance
NFR2: View shall render its initial state within 16ms (60fps target)
NFR3: Memory footprint for this view shall not exceed 2MB including animation state
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create WelcomeOnboardingView.swift file in Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Screens/ directory
Step 2: Define the view struct conforming to View protocol with body computed property
Step 3: Add @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) var reduceMotion property wrapper
Step 4: Add @State private var animationComplete = false for animation state tracking
Step 5: Implement logo Image view with conditional scale and opacity modifiers based on animation state
Step 6: Add onAppear modifier to trigger withAnimation block for 1.2s logo animation
Step 7: Implement headline Text view with appropriate font styling (.largeTitle or custom)
Step 8: Create VStack with three bullet point Text views for value propositions
Step 9: Implement Get Started Button with action closure calling coordinator.advanceToNextScreen()
Step 10: Apply padding, spacing, and alignment modifiers for visual layout
Step 11: Add conditional logic to skip animation when reduceMotion is true
data_model_changes: No data model changes - this screen is purely presentational
api_contracts: OnboardingCoordinator.advanceToNextScreen() -> Void: Called when Get Started button is tapped
event_contracts: onboarding_welcome_cta_tapped: Emitted when Get Started button is tapped
ui_states: Initial: Logo at scale 0.8 and opacity 0.0, headline and bullets visible, button enabled
Animating: Logo transitioning from scale 0.8 to 1.0 and opacity 0.0 to 1.0 over 1.2 seconds
Animation Complete: Logo at scale 1.0 and opacity 1.0, all elements visible
Reduced Motion: Logo immediately at scale 1.0 and opacity 1.0, no animation played
ui_interactions: User waits for logo animation to complete (passive)
User reads headline and value proposition bullets (passive)
User taps Get Started button to advance to next screen
ui_copy: Seamlessly connect to Claude, Gemini, and Codex CLIs
Visual governance with review and approval flows
Rich workspace with diffs, tasks, and timeline
edge_cases: User taps Get Started before animation completes - button should still function
User has reduced motion enabled - animation should be skipped entirely
Window is resized during animation - layout should adapt without breaking animation
User dismisses window during animation - animation should cancel cleanly
VoiceOver is active - all text elements should be accessible
failure_modes: Logo asset missing from bundle - display fallback SF Symbol (sparkles) with error log
OnboardingCoordinator unavailable - button tap logs error but does not crash
Animation state gets stuck - timeout after 2 seconds and set animationComplete = true
rollback_plan: Delete WelcomeOnboardingView.swift and remove any references from OnboardingCoordinator. Restore previous direct-to-main flow if onboarding was not previously implemented.

unit: Test that animationComplete state changes to true after animation duration
Test that reduceMotion = true skips animation and sets animationComplete immediately
Test that button action closure is called when button is activated
Test that all UI copy strings match specification
integration: Test that OnboardingCoordinator.advanceToNextScreen() is called when button tapped
Test navigation from WelcomeOnboardingView to next screen in flow
Test that telemetry events are emitted at correct lifecycle points
ui: Snapshot test of initial state before animation
Snapshot test of final state after animation complete
Snapshot test with reduced motion enabled
Test button has minimum 44pt touch target
perf: Verify animation completes within 1200ms tolerance of 50ms
Verify view body evaluation completes under 16ms
Memory profile shows no leaks during animation cycle
security: No security tests required - screen has no user input or data handling

metrics.name: welcome_screen_view_duration_ms
metrics.notes: Time user spends on welcome screen before tapping Get Started

metrics.name: welcome_animation_completed
metrics.notes: Track if animation completes vs is skipped due to reduced motion

log_expectations: DEBUG Navigating to next onboarding screen
acceptance_tests: Given the app launches for the first time, when the onboarding flow begins, then the WelcomeOnboardingView is displayed
Given the WelcomeOnboardingView is displayed, when the view appears, then the logo animation plays for 1.2 seconds
Given reduced motion is enabled, when the WelcomeOnboardingView appears, then no animation plays and logo is immediately visible
Given the WelcomeOnboardingView is displayed, when user taps Get Started, then the next onboarding screen is displayed
acceptance_criteria: Logo animation plays on view appear and completes within 1.2 seconds
Get Started button advances to Screen 2 (O003-PROFILE)
All UI copy matches specification exactly
View compiles without warnings and tests pass

criteria: WelcomeOnboardingView.swift exists and compiles without errors
All unit tests pass in WelcomeOnboardingViewTests
Integration test confirms navigation to next screen works
Animation timing verified to be 1.2 seconds

completed_when: WelcomeOnboardingView is fully implemented with animation, accessibility support, navigation, and all tests pass in CI.
completed_evidence: CI pipeline shows green status for WelcomeOnboardingViewTests, manual QA confirms animation plays correctly and Get Started navigates to profile screen.
status_reason: Atom defined and ready for implementation. No blockers identified.
open_questions: Should the logo animation have a bounce or spring effect, or pure linear scale and fade?
What specific font weight and size should the headline use?
Are the three value proposition bullets final copy or placeholder?
notes: This is the first screen users see in Blaze. First impressions matter - the animation should feel polished but not slow. Consider A/B testing animation duration in future.

na_justifications.data_model_changes[0]: Welcome screen is purely presentational with no data persistence or model requirements
na_justifications.dependency_ids: No atom dependencies - this is the first screen in the onboarding flow
na_justifications.security_tests: No security tests needed - screen has no user input, no network calls, no data handling

verification_steps: Run swift build and verify WelcomeOnboardingView.swift compiles without errors or warnings
Run swift test --filter WelcomeOnboardingViewTests and verify all tests pass
Launch app in simulator, verify logo animation plays for approximately 1.2 seconds on first launch
Enable reduced motion in System Preferences > Accessibility, relaunch app, verify no animation plays
Tap Get Started button and verify navigation advances to profile screen

risks: Animation timing may feel too slow or too fast depending on user perception
Logo asset may not exist yet causing build failure
OnboardingCoordinator API may change requiring updates
mitigations: Make animation duration a constant that can be easily tuned
Add fallback SF Symbol if logo asset is missing
Use protocol for coordinator to decouple from concrete implementation
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to onboarding flow. Does not affect main app functionality. Only impacts first-launch experience.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If issues arise, skip welcome screen and start onboarding at profile screen. Can be toggled via feature flag.

state: reduceMotion: Bool from system accessibility setting
persistence: No persistence - screen is stateless and presentational only
